question: Which metric is MOST appropriate for capturing the user-perceived responsiveness of an LLM-based chat endpoint?
options: Average CPU utilization of the model server
p99 end-to-end latency including token generation
Training loss of the underlying model
explanation: p99 end-to-end latency directly measures the worst-case user experience, including token streaming delays. CPU utilization and GPU count are infrastructure metrics, not user-facing. Training loss is a model development metric, not a deployment metric.

question: If a service has an SLO of 99.9% availability over 30 days, what is its error budget in minutes?
explanation: 30 days = 43,200 minutes. 0.1% of 43,200 = 43.2 minutes. The error budget is the allowed downtime. 4.32 minutes would be for 99.99% (four nines). 432 minutes is 1% (two nines). 0.432 minutes is 0.001% (five nines).
